registered: 2026-10-17, before any replay of this arm
asked_by: running list / handoff 10/16 item 5: EQNR 12:21 and PPL 14:03 were sold at entry after the 15s idle leash and green_catchup_overtake walked the stop up. Check whether overtake bypasses ai_local_trail_be_at_pct 0.15. It does: local_profit_stop returns last on that path without consulting be_at_pct. Live config is not changed.
code: ai_positions._cap_shelf_under_entry_until_be. Flag ai_local_trail_entry_cap_until_be defaults false. True: until be_hit (the existing be_at_pct / be_at_r / spread-k rule), a shelf raise may not land at or above entry. Cap is entry minus 1 cent. A shelf already at or above entry is not pulled down.
arm: trail_dc_entrycap = trail_dc plus the flag true. Reference is trail_dc rerun at the SAME sha. Do not compare with the 8bbede5 trail_dc files.
script: scripts/exit_cut_sweep.sh. Not launched in this registration. Commit the cap first. The replay archives that commit (git archive of SHA). Do not set SWEEP_SHA to a parent of the cap commit, or both arms run identical code.

launch.note: The script's pooled result.md is not the verdict. SWEEP_DAYTIME is required so the replays use the data-only account and do not wait for 16:15.

halves: A = 2026-10-06..2026-10-09, B = 2026-10-12..2026-10-15. Score each half by copying exactly those four days for both arms into its own directory and running tools/studies/spread_rvol_score.py --dir <half> --arms trail_dc,trail_dc_entrycap --refs trail_dc. The printed paired line 'trail_dc_entrycap - trail_dc' is the decision t. All 8 day-files must exist for both arms (16 files). A day the scorer marks incomplete or vacuous fails the study. There is no trade-count floor and none may be added after the replays.
metric: VALUE = sum of net bp per day (net = return minus full SIP spread at entry), day-clustered, paired vs trail_dc. Same scorer as the exit-cut sweep (tools/studies/spread_rvol_score.py).
scratch: Counted by tools/studies/entry_cap_score.py on closed[]. A scratch is abs(exit_px - entry_px) <= 0.01, unless peak_px is present and (peak_px - entry_px) / entry_px >= 0.0015. A missing peak_px with an exit within 1 cent stays a scratch. Count per arm per half.
decision: Ship only if the paired VALUE t is >= 1.5 in BOTH halves AND the entry-cap scratch count is strictly lower than trail_dc in both halves. Otherwise the live leash stays. No config edit in this study. No minimum trade count.
prior: LOW. The leash is the best-tested exit (+58 bp/day on the 10/16 rerun). This arm takes away the early raise to entry. Expect fewer scratches and possibly worse value if those scratches were avoiding later losses.
